name: WCT-BEES Grassroots Conservation Small Grant
summary: Small grants for Indian citizens and registered organisations running field conservation of endangered species or exceptional biodiversity landscapes in India, in projects of up to ten months.

eligibility.rule: Be an Indian citizen or an organisation with a valid registration certificate for operations in India
Hold at least a graduate degree from a recognised university
Focus the project on endangered species or landscapes of exceptional biodiversity value in India
Keep the project duration at 10 months or less
Have measurable outcomes that lead to tangible conservation benefits
Exclude conference or laboratory-analysis travel, permanent infrastructure, enforcement work and litigation

documents: Budget in the given format with a detailed cost breakdown and description
No Objection Certificate from the other grantor, if using another matching grant

effort.quote: The application deadline for the WCT-BEES Grants Programme is July 20, 2026 (23:59 IST).
Referees should ideally submit recommendation letters within 7-10 days of being contacted.

The proposals will be meticulously appraised by the Selection Committee instituted by WCT, and approved based on their alignment with the programme, and the merit and significance of their conservation goals, amongst other criteria.

eligibility.quote: Grants under the programme are only applicable to Indian citizens and organisations with a valid registration certificate for operations in India.
Applicants need to hold a minimum of a graduate degree from a recognised university.
Only one project should be submitted by any individual or organisation.
Projects should focus on the conservation of endangered species and/or landscapes of exceptional biodiversity value in India.
Projects pitched to WCT cannot exceed a duration of 10 months.
The project must have measurable outcomes that lead to tangible conservation benefits.

attending conferences/seminars, or carrying out laboratory analysis. WCT-BEES Grants cannot be used for building permanent infrastructure. WCT-BEES Grants will not be applicable for undercover or enforcement work. WCT-BEES Grants cannot be used for expenses related to litigation.
